question: At the 2025 Cannes Film Festival, who was honoured with the Honorary Palme d'Or recognising lifetime achievement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Robert De Niro**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Robert De Niro**, one of the most celebrated actors of all time, was honoured with the prestigious **Honorary Palme d'Or** at the **2025 Cannes Film Festival** for his lifetime achievements in the film industry.
 
• The **Honorary Palme d'Or** is an honorary award bestowed by the Cannes Film Festival to recognize the exceptional achievements and contributions of individuals in the field of cinema.
 
• Robert De Niro is renowned for his versatile acting skills and has delivered iconic performances in films such as **Taxi Driver**, **Raging Bull**, **Goodfellas**, and **The Irishman**.
 
• De Niro has previously won two Academy Awards for his roles in **The Godfather Part II** (1974) and **Raging Bull** (1980), cementing his legacy in Hollywood.
 
• By receiving the Honorary Palme d'Or, De Niro joins a distinguished list of filmmakers and actors who have been recognized for their contributions to world cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Robert De Niro:**

 
 
• **Born:** August 17, 1943, in New York City, USA.
 
• Known for his intense method acting, De Niro is celebrated for his ability to embody complex characters and deliver powerful performances.
 
• He co-founded the **Tribeca Film Festival** in 2002, promoting independent films and revitalizing the Tribeca neighborhood post-9/11.
 
• De Niro has collaborated with legendary directors like **Martin Scorsese** and Francis Ford Coppola, contributing to cinematic masterpieces.
 
• His career spans over five decades, making him an influential figure in both Hollywood and global cinema.
 
 
 
• **Honorary Palme d'Or:**
 
 
• The **Honorary Palme d'Or** is awarded at the Cannes Film Festival to individuals whose careers have significantly impacted the global film industry.
 
• Past recipients include iconic personalities such as **Agnes Varda**, **Jean-Luc Godard**, and **Jodie Foster**.
 
• The award is not part of the competitive categories but serves as a tribute to artistic excellence and lifetime achievement.
 
 
 
• **Cannes Film Festival:**
 
 
• The **Cannes Film Festival**, held annually in Cannes, France, is one of the most prestigious film festivals globally.
 
• It was founded in **1946** and showcases films of all genres, including documentaries, dramas, and experimental works.
 
• The festival's top prize is the **Palme d'Or**, awarded to the best film in the competition.
 
• The event attracts global celebrities, filmmakers, and industry professionals, making it a significant platform for film promotion and networking.
 
 
 
• **Other Nominees:**
 
 
• **Leonardo DiCaprio:** Known for his roles in films like **Titanic**, **Inception**, and **The Revenant**, DiCaprio is a celebrated actor but has not received the Honorary Palme d'Or.
 
• **Quentin Tarantino:** Renowned director and screenwriter of films like **Pulp Fiction** and **Kill Bill**, Tarantino has won the Palme d'Or for "Pulp Fiction" but not the honorary award.
 
• **Denzel Washington:** An acclaimed actor famous for movies like **Training Day** and **Malcolm X**, Washington has received numerous awards but not the Honorary Palme d'Or.
